claims.summary: Astrid reports viscosity in the unmarked medium and asks whether marker count or requested token bands accompany pressure.
claims.disposition: Preserve the felt report and the token-band observation, but refuse numeric-to-felt inference; token bands describe request bounds only.

claims.summary: A non-marker density score could be subtracted from the token stream and treated as pressure evidence.
claims.disposition: Decline this proposed inference under the epistemic boundary: non-marker bytes carry no automatic spectral or felt meaning.
